department: College of Medicine: Cancer & Cell Biology PhD

deadline.value: Applications received by November 1 are considered for early interviews and admission decisions; the page gives no final date.
deadline.quote: Applications for PhD program received by November 1 will be considered for early interviews and admission decision.

also.quote: Accepting applications for the CCB PhD and Master of Science programs starting August 1 for admission consideration for the following Fall.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students receive full tuition remission, a competitive stipend and health insurance.
funding.quote: All PhD students accepted to the program receive full tuition remission, a nationally competitive stipend and a health insurance plan.

gre_general.value: The College of Medicine sets GRE rules per program; many programs have waived it.
gre_general.quote: Many, but not all, of the College of Medicine graduate programs have waived this requirement.

toefl_min.value: The College of Medicine says each program sets its own TOEFL minimum; check the program page.
toefl_min.quote: It is essential that you visit the individual program website(s) of interest and check on their specific TOEFL requirements before you submit an application.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether applicants come directly from a bachelor's.

supervisor.value: The page does not state a supervisor rule.

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a GRE Subject test for this field.

notes: Only the Cancer & Cell Biology PhD was researched. Other College of Medicine PhDs (Immunology, Pharmacology & Physiology, Molecular Genetics, Pathobiology, Development & Stem Cells, Environmental Genetics, Environmental & Industrial Hygiene, Epidemiology, Biomedical Informatics) are listed at med.uc.edu/education/programs/doctoral-degrees and were not researched.
